insecure.title: Microphone unavailable
insecure.body: The app is not running in a secure context, so the microphone cannot be reached. Open the app window itself rather than a page served over plain HTTP.

mic.supportHint: Still stuck? Check Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone, then Sound settings → Input.
mic.settingsDescription: Recording a voice note needs a microphone and the app's permission to use it. This is checked here, without asking for permission.
mic.managePermissionsBody: The microphone prompt belongs to the app window, not to a website. Windows keeps the answer per app: Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone, and make sure the app is listed and switched on. Then press Retry here.
mic.openSoundSettingsFailed: Could not open the sound settings on this system. Open them manually: Windows Settings → System → Sound → Input.

bubble.retryTranscriptionFailed: Could not transcribe this voice note.

actions.regenerateUnavailable: Regenerating a reply is not available in this build. The engine has no way to re-run a reply without sending your last message again.
actions.forwardUnavailable: This message has no text to forward.
actions.deleteConfirmMessage: Delete this message? This cannot be undone.
actions.replyUnavailable: the original message is no longer available
